<!-- Generated by `pnpm --filter @outstaff/office run docs:pipeline`. Do not edit by hand. -->

These are the built-in policies the office runs, in evaluation order ([decision 0018](/decisions/0018-pipeline-only/)). Each is a module in `packages/office/src/pipeline/policies/`, and this page is generated from them. Every policy that listens to an event receives it and proposes; the aggregation layer turns the proposals into the decisions. [What outstaff does on its own](/concepts/automation/) explains the events and the decisions, and [Writing a policy](/guides/writing-a-policy/) how to add a policy of your own.

A team changes a policy under [`pipeline.policies.<id>`](/reference/team-yaml/#pipelinepolicies) in team.yaml: `enabled: false` turns it off (it stays in the trace), `instruction` replaces the instruction of a wake or the note of an act, and `when` narrows it, so both its own condition and the team's must hold. Policies of the team's own, under [`policies.custom`](/reference/team-yaml/#policiescustom), run after these.

## Overview

| Policy | Listens to | Decides |

| [`chat_to_addressed`](#chat_to_addressed) | `chat.message` | wake `addressed` (kind `chat`) |
| [`review_to_author`](#review_to_author) | `pr.review_submitted`, `pr.comment` | wake `author` (kind `review_feedback`) |
| [`merged_feedback_to_author`](#merged_feedback_to_author) | `pr.review_submitted`, `pr.comment` | wake `author` (kind `merged_feedback`) |
| [`merged_closes_ticket`](#merged_closes_ticket) | `pr.merge_checks_passed` | act for `author`, else `assignee`, else `last_worker`: move the ticket to `done`, assign it to the agent acted for |
| [`merge_checks_failed_to_agent`](#merge_checks_failed_to_agent) | `pr.merge_checks_failed` | wake `author`, else `assignee`, else `last_worker` (kind `merge_checks_failed`) |
| [`rebase_to_author`](#rebase_to_author) | `pr.conflicted`, `pr.behind_base`, `pr.base_merged` | wake `author` (kind `rebase`) |
| [`ci_failed_to_author`](#ci_failed_to_author) | `pr.ci_failed` | wake `author` (kind `ci_failed`) |
| [`merge_ready`](#merge_ready) | `pr.review_submitted`, `pr.ci_passed`, `pr.base_merged` | wake `author` (kind `merge`) with the merge context, when its checks are green and the repository is in `policies.merge.repos` |
| [`opened_to_review`](#opened_to_review) | `pr.opened` | act for `author`, else `assignee`, else `last_worker`: move the ticket to `review` |
| [`link_pr_on_ticket`](#link_pr_on_ticket) | `pr.opened`, `pr.linked` | act for `author`: link the pull request on the ticket, when the tracker can link pull requests (`tracker.development`) |
| [`assigned_to_assignee`](#assigned_to_assignee) | `ticket.assigned`, `ticket.created` | wake `assignee` (kind `assigned`) |
| [`ticket_comment_to_agent`](#ticket_comment_to_agent) | `ticket.commented` | wake `assignee` (kind `ticket_comment`) |
| [`ticket_comment_to_mentioned_agent`](#ticket_comment_to_mentioned_agent) | `ticket.commented` | wake `mentioned` (kind `asked`) |
| [`ticket_comment_to_blocked_agent`](#ticket_comment_to_blocked_agent) | `ticket.commented` | wake `blocked_agent` (kind `ticket_comment`) |
| [`ticket_comment_to_last_worker`](#ticket_comment_to_last_worker) | `ticket.commented` | wake `last_worker` (kind `ticket_comment`) |
| [`moved_active_to_assignee`](#moved_active_to_assignee) | `ticket.moved` | wake `assignee` (kind `assigned`) |
| [`moved_active_to_last_worker`](#moved_active_to_last_worker) | `ticket.moved` | act for `last_worker`: assign it to the agent acted for, then wake them (kind `assigned`) |
| [`closed_stops_work`](#closed_stops_work) | `ticket.closed` | stop the work on the ticket of every agent but the one who closed it; a ticket closed as done by an unknown closer or an automation stops nothing |
| [`subticket_closed_to_agent`](#subticket_closed_to_agent) | `ticket.closed` | wake `assignee`, else `last_worker`, else the parent's agent (kind `assigned`) on the ticket's parent, the first of them with more unfinished sub-tickets of the parent |
| [`subtickets_closed_move_parent`](#subtickets_closed_move_parent) | `ticket.closed` | act for the parent's agent: move the parent to `done` and assign it to the agent, when its own pull requests merged, else to `review` and assign it to the requester; when the closed ticket was its last open sub-ticket |
| [`unblocked_to_blocked_agent`](#unblocked_to_blocked_agent) | `ticket.unblocked` | wake `blocked_agent` (kind `unblocked`) |
| [`unblocked_to_ready`](#unblocked_to_ready) | `ticket.unblocked` | act for `assignee`: move the ticket to `ready`, then wake them (kind `assigned`), unless the blocker is a sub-ticket of the same parent and the parent is with that agent (`parentAgent`): then only move it; with no agent assigned, act for `closer`: move the ticket to `ready` |
| [`doc_comment_to_agent`](#doc_comment_to_agent) | `doc.commented` | wake `mentioned`, else `doc_author` (kind `doc_feedback`) |
| [`doc_comment_to_mentioned_agent`](#doc_comment_to_mentioned_agent) | `doc.commented` | wake `mentioned` (kind `doc_feedback`) |
| [`link_doc_on_ticket`](#link_doc_on_ticket) | `doc.linked` | act for `doc_author`, else `actor`: link the document on the ticket, when the knowledge base can link documents on tickets (`knowledge.issueLinks`) |
| [`start_marks_active`](#start_marks_active) | `agent.started` | act for `actor`: assign it to the agent acted for, move the ticket to `active` |
| [`hand_back_done`](#hand_back_done) | `agent.handed_back` | act for `actor`: move the ticket to `review`, assign it to the requester, unless the agent handed the ticket over to someone else; a ticket with open sub-tickets stays `active` with the agent instead; the item's other tickets awaiting review (the ones it created that are in review, and the ones whose pull request it opened) move to `review` and go to the requester |
| [`hand_back_silent_restores`](#hand_back_silent_restores) | `agent.handed_back` | act for the agent: move the ticket back to the status it had before the round, and assign it back to whom it had, for each of the two still as the round's start set it; the item's other tickets awaiting review (the ones it created that are in review, and the ones whose pull request it opened) move to `review` and go to the requester |
| [`hand_back_blocked`](#hand_back_blocked) | `agent.handed_back` | act for `actor`: move the ticket to `blocked`, assign it to the requester, when no PM unblocks it, unless the agent handed the ticket over to someone else; the item's other tickets awaiting review (the ones it created that are in review, and the ones whose pull request it opened) move to `review` and go to the requester |
| [`hand_back_blocked_to_pm`](#hand_back_blocked_to_pm) | `agent.handed_back` | act for `actor`: move the ticket to `blocked`, assign it to `role:pm`; then wake `role:pm` (kind `unblock`), when the PM is not the blocked agent, unless the agent handed the ticket over to someone else; the item's other tickets awaiting review (the ones it created that are in review, and the ones whose pull request it opened) move to `review` and go to the requester |
| [`idle_pulls_next`](#idle_pulls_next) | `agent.idle` | wake `actor` (kind `assigned`), with its next ready ticket (for a sub-ticket, on its parent) |

## Policies

### chat_to_addressed

A chat message wakes the agent it was written to.

Listens to `chat.message`. Decides: wake `addressed` (kind `chat`).

When:

- `actor_kind: human`

Instruction:

```text
{{actor.id}} wrote to you in chat. Answer in the thread. If they ask for work, decide how it fits your queue.
```

### review_to_author

A human's review or comment on an agent's open pull request wakes its author.

Listens to `pr.review_submitted`, `pr.comment`. Decides: wake `author` (kind `review_feedback`).

When:

- all of:
  - `actor_kind: human`
  - `pr_author_kind: agent`
  - `pr_open: true`
  - not:
    - all of:
      - `review_state: approved`
      - `has_body: false`

Instruction:

```text
{{actor.id}} left feedback on your pull request #{{pr.number}} ({{pr.title}}). Address each point, answer in its thread and push.
```

### merged_feedback_to_author

A human's review or comment on an agent's merged pull request wakes its author.

Listens to `pr.review_submitted`, `pr.comment`. Decides: wake `author` (kind `merged_feedback`).

When:

- all of:
  - `actor_kind: human`
  - `pr_author_kind: agent`
  - `pr_merged: true`
  - not:
    - all of:
      - `review_state: approved`
      - `has_body: false`

Instruction:

```text
{{actor.id}} commented on your merged pull request #{{pr.number}} ({{pr.title}}). Answer there. If they ask for a change, open a follow-up pull request.
```

### merged_closes_ticket

A merge into the default branch closes the ticket once the checks on its merge commit pass (or none start), unless another of its pull requests or one of its sub-tickets is open; the ticket ends with the agent who did the work: for the author, or, for a human's pull request, the agent the ticket is assigned to, else the agent who last worked on it.

Listens to `pr.merge_checks_passed`. Decides: act for `author`, else `assignee`, else `last_worker`: move the ticket to `done`, assign it to the agent acted for.

When:

- all of:
  - `ticket_status: backlog, ready, active, review, blocked`
  - `pr_base_default: true`
  - not:
    - `ticket_prs_open: true`
  - not:
    - `open_subtickets: true`

Note posted with the change:

```text
Moved to done: pull request #{{pr.number}} by {{pr.author}} merged and the checks on its merge commit passed.
```

### merge_checks_failed_to_agent

A check that fails on the merge commit of a pull request in the default branch, such as a deploy, wakes the ticket's agent with the failed step's log: the pull request's author, or, for a human's pull request, the agent the ticket is assigned to, else the agent who last worked on it. The ticket stays open.

Listens to `pr.merge_checks_failed`. Decides: wake `author`, else `assignee`, else `last_worker` (kind `merge_checks_failed`).

When:

- all of:
  - `pr_merged: true`
  - not:
    - `ticket_status: canceled`

Instruction:

```text
Pull request #{{pr.number}} ({{pr.title}}) by {{pr.author}} merged, but checks on its merge commit failed: {{checks}}. The end of the failed step's log is in the context; `ost ci log <check link>` reads more. Fix it the way the repository asks, for example with a follow-up pull request on the same ticket. The ticket stays open until a merge for it passes its checks.
```

### rebase_to_author

An agent's open pull request that conflicts, is behind its base, or whose base merged wakes its author, naming the merge that caused it.

Listens to `pr.conflicted`, `pr.behind_base`, `pr.base_merged`. Decides: wake `author` (kind `rebase`).

When:

- all of:
  - `pr_author_kind: agent`
  - `pr_open: true`
  - not:
    - `ticket_status: canceled`

Instruction:

```text
Your pull request #{{pr.number}} ({{pr.title}}) {{pr.problem}}{{cause}}. Bring it up to date with `{{pr.base}}` the way the repository asks, and push. Then keep the pull request description current; if the approach changed, comment with what changed and why.
```

### ci_failed_to_author

Failing checks on an agent's open pull request wake its author.

Listens to `pr.ci_failed`. Decides: wake `author` (kind `ci_failed`).

When:

- all of:
  - `pr_author_kind: agent`
  - `pr_open: true`
  - not:
    - `ticket_status: canceled`

Instruction:

```text
Your pull request #{{pr.number}} ({{pr.title}}) {{pr.problem}}. The failing checks are in the feedback. Fix them and push.
```

### merge_ready

An agent's approved pull request that may be ready to merge wakes its author to decide (policies.merge.on_approval): an allowed approver approves it with its checks green, its checks turn green, or the pull request it was stacked on merges. Not while an allowed approver's request for changes is outstanding.

Listens to `pr.review_submitted`, `pr.ci_passed`, `pr.base_merged`. Decides: wake `author` (kind `merge`) with the merge context, when its checks are green and the repository is in `policies.merge.repos`.

On only while `policies.merge.on_approval` is on.

When:

- all of:
  - all of:
    - `pr_author_kind: agent`
    - `pr_open: true`
    - not:
      - `ticket_status: canceled`
  - `pr_draft: false`
  - `pr_approved: true`

Instruction:

```text
#{{pr.number}} ({{pr.title}}) is approved and may be ready to merge. Decide whether to merge it now, wait, or coordinate first; follow the repository's instructions on merging.
```

### opened_to_review

A pull request opened for review moves its ticket to review: for the author, or, for a human's pull request, the agent the ticket is assigned to, else the agent who last worked on it. A ticket with open sub-tickets stays active until the last one closes.

Listens to `pr.opened`. Decides: act for `author`, else `assignee`, else `last_worker`: move the ticket to `review`.

When:

- all of:
  - not:
    - `pr_draft: true`
  - `ticket_status: backlog, ready, active`
  - not:
    - `open_subtickets: true`

Note posted with the change:

```text
Moved to review: pull request #{{pr.number}} by {{pr.author}} is open for review.
```

### link_pr_on_ticket

An agent's pull request opened for a ticket, or linked to one after it was opened, is shown on the ticket in the tracker (its development section), by the author with its own tracker account. Bookkeeping: it wakes no one.

Listens to `pr.opened`, `pr.linked`. Decides: act for `author`: link the pull request on the ticket, when the tracker can link pull requests (`tracker.development`).

When: always.

Note posted with the change: none, since the ticket shows the change. A team can add one with `pipeline.policies.link_pr_on_ticket.instruction`.

### assigned_to_assignee

A ticket assigned to an agent, by anyone but that agent, wakes the agent.

Listens to `ticket.assigned`, `ticket.created`. Decides: wake `assignee` (kind `assigned`).

When:

- all of:
  - `assignee_kind: agent`
  - not:
    - `actor_kind: automation`
  - not:
    - `actor_is: assignee`
  - not:
    - `ticket_status: done, canceled`

Instruction:

```text
{{ticket}} is assigned to you. Work on it the way the repository asks.
```

### ticket_comment_to_agent

A human's comment, mentioning no agent, on a ticket assigned to an agent wakes that agent.

Listens to `ticket.commented`. Decides: wake `assignee` (kind `ticket_comment`).

When:

- all of:
  - `actor_kind: human`
  - not:
    - `ticket_status: done, canceled`
  - not:
    - `agent_mentioned: true`
  - `assignee_kind: agent`

Instruction:

```text
{{actor.id}} commented on {{ticket}}. Read the comment and act on it.
```

### ticket_comment_to_mentioned_agent

A comment on a ticket, by a human or another agent, wakes the agent it mentions first, to answer or act on it; the ticket stays with its assignee. An agent's comment that mentions no other agent wakes no one.

Listens to `ticket.commented`. Decides: wake `mentioned` (kind `asked`).

When:

- all of:
  - not:
    - `actor_kind: automation`
  - not:
    - `ticket_status: done, canceled`
  - `agent_mentioned: true`

Instruction:

```text
{{actor.id}} mentioned you in a comment on {{ticket}}. Read the comment and answer it, or do what it asks, on the ticket. The ticket stays with its assignee: leave its assignee and status as they are, unless the comment asks you to take the ticket over.
```

### ticket_comment_to_blocked_agent

A comment on a blocked ticket, by a human or an agent other than the agent blocked on it, wakes the agent blocked on it; unless the ticket is with an agent (who is unblocking it), the comment mentions an agent (that agent is woken), or an agent comments during its own round on the ticket.

Listens to `ticket.commented`. Decides: wake `blocked_agent` (kind `ticket_comment`).

When:

- all of:
  - `blocked_agent: true`
  - not:
    - `actor_kind: automation`
  - not:
    - `actor_is: blocked_agent`
  - not:
    - `assignee_kind: agent`
  - not:
    - `agent_mentioned: true`
  - not:
    - `actor_in_round: true`

Instruction:

```text
{{actor.id}} commented on {{ticket}}, which you handed back as blocked. Read the comment. If it unblocks the work, assign the ticket to yourself, move it to active and continue. Otherwise answer on the ticket what is still missing.
```

### ticket_comment_to_last_worker

A human's comment, mentioning no agent, on a ticket handed back to a human (in review, or blocked with no agent blocked on it) wakes the agent who last worked on it.

Listens to `ticket.commented`. Decides: wake `last_worker` (kind `ticket_comment`).

When:

- all of:
  - `actor_kind: human`
  - not:
    - `agent_mentioned: true`
  - `assignee_kind: human`
  - `ticket_status: review, blocked`
  - not:
    - `blocked_agent: true`

Instruction:

```text
{{actor.id}} commented on {{ticket}}, which you handed back. Answer the comment on the ticket. If it needs more work, assign the ticket to yourself, move it to active and do the work.
```

### moved_active_to_assignee

A human moving a ticket to active wakes the agent assigned.

Listens to `ticket.moved`. Decides: wake `assignee` (kind `assigned`).

When:

- all of:
  - `actor_kind: human`
  - `moved_to: active`
  - `assignee_kind: agent`

Instruction:

```text
{{actor.id}} moved {{ticket}} to active. Pick the work up.
```

### moved_active_to_last_worker

A human moving a ticket assigned to a human to active, without the needs-human label, gives it back to the agent who last worked on it and wakes them.

Listens to `ticket.moved`. Decides: act for `last_worker`: assign it to the agent acted for, then wake them (kind `assigned`).

When:

- all of:
  - `actor_kind: human`
  - `moved_to: active`
  - `assignee_kind: human`
  - not:
    - `has_label: $needs_human`

Instruction:

```text
{{actor.id}} moved {{ticket}} to active and it is assigned to you again. Pick the work up.
```

Note posted with the change: none; the instruction is the wake's.

### closed_stops_work

A ticket canceled, or closed as done by someone other than the agent working on it, stops the work on it: every agent's queued work on it and its pull requests is canceled, and an agent running such work is told to stop when its round ends. The agent who closed the ticket is left alone.

Listens to `ticket.closed`. Decides: stop the work on the ticket of every agent but the one who closed it; a ticket closed as done by an unknown closer or an automation stops nothing.

When:

- `ticket_status: done, canceled`

Note posted with the change:

```text
{{ticket}} was {{closed}} by {{closer}} at {{closed.at}}. Stop, and don't open a pull request for it. If the work belongs to another ticket, say which and hand back.
```

### subticket_closed_to_agent

A sub-ticket closing wakes an agent on the parent ticket when the parent is open and that agent has more unfinished sub-tickets of it: the closed sub-ticket's agent, else the parent's. The agent planned their order when it split the parent, and picks the next one.

Listens to `ticket.closed`. Decides: wake `assignee`, else `last_worker`, else the parent's agent (kind `assigned`) on the ticket's parent, the first of them with more unfinished sub-tickets of the parent.

When:

- all of:
  - `ticket_status: done, canceled`
  - `parent_status: backlog, ready, active, review, blocked`

Instruction:

```text
{{ticket}} was {{closed}}. The open sub-tickets of {{parent}}: {{parent.open}}. Continue with the next one in the order you planned, the way the repository asks.
```

### subtickets_closed_move_parent

The last open sub-ticket of an active parent closing moves the parent on, for its agent: to done, with the agent, when the parent's own pull requests merged; otherwise to review, with the requester.

Listens to `ticket.closed`. Decides: act for the parent's agent: move the parent to `done` and assign it to the agent, when its own pull requests merged, else to `review` and assign it to the requester; when the closed ticket was its last open sub-ticket.

When:

- all of:
  - `ticket_status: done, canceled`
  - `parent_status: active`

Note posted with the change: none, since the ticket shows the change. A team can add one with `pipeline.policies.subtickets_closed_move_parent.instruction`.

### unblocked_to_blocked_agent

A blocked ticket whose last open blocker was closed wakes the agent blocked on it, to check whether it can go on; the ticket stays where it is, since it may be blocked for other reasons too.

Listens to `ticket.unblocked`. Decides: wake `blocked_agent` (kind `unblocked`).

When:

- `blocked_agent: true`

Instruction:

```text
{{blocker}}, which blocked {{ticket}}, is closed, and no other ticket blocks it. You handed {{ticket}} back as blocked: check whether you can continue now. If so, assign it to yourself, move it to active and continue. Otherwise answer on the ticket what is still missing.
```

### unblocked_to_ready

A blocked ticket whose last open blocker was closed, with no agent blocked on it, was only waiting on its blockers: it moves to ready, for the agent it is assigned to, who is then woken; else for the agent who closed the blocker. When the blocker is a sub-ticket of the same parent and that parent is with the same agent, the ticket is only moved and no one is woken here: the agent holding the parent coordinates its sub-tickets, and the idle pull starts this one when it has nothing queued.

Listens to `ticket.unblocked`. Decides: act for `assignee`: move the ticket to `ready`, then wake them (kind `assigned`), unless the blocker is a sub-ticket of the same parent and the parent is with that agent (`parentAgent`): then only move it; with no agent assigned, act for `closer`: move the ticket to `ready`.

When:

- all of:
  - `ticket_status: blocked`
  - not:
    - `blocked_agent: true`

Instruction:

```text
{{blocker}}, which blocked {{ticket}}, is closed, and no other ticket blocks it: {{ticket}} is ready again. Work on it the way the repository asks.
```

Note posted with the change: none; the instruction is the wake's.

### doc_comment_to_agent

A human's comment on a document wakes the agent it mentions, else the agent who wrote it.

Listens to `doc.commented`. Decides: wake `mentioned`, else `doc_author` (kind `doc_feedback`).

When:

- `actor_kind: human`

Instruction:

```text
{{actor.id}} commented on the document {{doc.title}}. Answer in the document and change it if needed.
```

### doc_comment_to_mentioned_agent

An agent's comment on a document wakes the other agent it mentions. An agent's comment that mentions no other agent wakes no one.

Listens to `doc.commented`. Decides: wake `mentioned` (kind `doc_feedback`).

When:

- all of:
  - `actor_kind: agent`
  - `agent_mentioned: true`

Instruction:

```text
{{actor.id}} mentioned you in a comment on the document {{doc.title}}. Answer in the document and change it if needed.
```

### link_doc_on_ticket

A document an agent wrote for a ticket, in a round on the ticket or attached to it later, is shown on the ticket in the tracker, by its author with its own account. Bookkeeping: it wakes no one.

Listens to `doc.linked`. Decides: act for `doc_author`, else `actor`: link the document on the ticket, when the knowledge base can link documents on tickets (`knowledge.issueLinks`).

When: always.

Note posted with the change: none, since the ticket shows the change. A team can add one with `pipeline.policies.link_doc_on_ticket.instruction`.

### start_marks_active

A round of work starting on a ticket assigns the ticket to the agent and moves it to active, for the agent.

Listens to `agent.started`. Decides: act for `actor`: assign it to the agent acted for, move the ticket to `active`.

When:

- all of:
  - `work_kind: assigned, review_feedback, ticket_comment, rebase, ci_failed, merge_checks_failed`
  - not:
    - `ticket_status: done, canceled`

Note posted with the change: none, since the ticket shows the change. A team can add one with `pipeline.policies.start_marks_active.instruction`.

### hand_back_done

A hand-back as done moves the ticket to review and gives it to the requester, for the agent, unless the agent handed the ticket over to someone else during the work; a ticket with open sub-tickets stays active with the agent instead. The work item's other tickets awaiting review (the ones it created that are in review, and the ones whose pull request it opened) go to review and to the requester too. A merge round's hand-back leaves the ticket as it is: nothing in it is left for the human.

Listens to `agent.handed_back`. Decides: act for `actor`: move the ticket to `review`, assign it to the requester, unless the agent handed the ticket over to someone else; a ticket with open sub-tickets stays `active` with the agent instead; the item's other tickets awaiting review (the ones it created that are in review, and the ones whose pull request it opened) move to `review` and go to the requester.

When:

- all of:
  - `hand_back_status: done`
  - not:
    - `work_kind: merge`
  - not:
    - `ticket_status: blocked, done, canceled`

Note posted with the change: none, since the ticket shows the change. A team can add one with `pipeline.policies.hand_back_done.instruction`.

### hand_back_silent_restores

A silent hand-back leaves the ticket as it was before the round: what the round's start changed (the move to active, the assignment to the agent) is undone, for the agent. A field someone changed since is left alone, and so is a parent the agent kept active for its open sub-tickets. The work item's other tickets awaiting review go to review and to the requester too.

Listens to `agent.handed_back`. Decides: act for the agent: move the ticket back to the status it had before the round, and assign it back to whom it had, for each of the two still as the round's start set it; the item's other tickets awaiting review (the ones it created that are in review, and the ones whose pull request it opened) move to `review` and go to the requester.

When:

- all of:
  - `hand_back_status: silent`
  - not:
    - `ticket_status: done, canceled`

Note posted with the change: none, since the ticket shows the change. A team can add one with `pipeline.policies.hand_back_silent_restores.instruction`.

### hand_back_blocked

A hand-back as blocked, or as done on a ticket the agent moved to blocked, on a team with no PM to unblock it (none, or the PM is the blocked agent), moves the ticket to blocked and gives it to the requester, for the agent, unless the agent handed the ticket over to someone else during the work. The work item's other tickets awaiting review (the ones it created that are in review, and the ones whose pull request it opened) go to review and to the requester.

Listens to `agent.handed_back`. Decides: act for `actor`: move the ticket to `blocked`, assign it to the requester, when no PM unblocks it, unless the agent handed the ticket over to someone else; the item's other tickets awaiting review (the ones it created that are in review, and the ones whose pull request it opened) move to `review` and go to the requester.

When:

- all of:
  - any of:
    - `hand_back_status: blocked`
    - all of:
      - `hand_back_status: done`
      - `ticket_status: blocked`
  - not:
    - `ticket_status: done, canceled`

Note posted with the change: none, since the ticket shows the change. A team can add one with `pipeline.policies.hand_back_blocked.instruction`.

### hand_back_blocked_to_pm

A hand-back as blocked, or as done on a ticket the agent moved to blocked, on a team with a PM other than the blocked agent, moves the ticket to blocked and gives it to the PM, for the agent, then wakes the PM to unblock it; unless the agent handed the ticket over to someone other than the PM during the work. The work item's other tickets awaiting review (the ones it created that are in review, and the ones whose pull request it opened) go to review and to the requester, not the PM.

Listens to `agent.handed_back`. Decides: act for `actor`: move the ticket to `blocked`, assign it to `role:pm`; then wake `role:pm` (kind `unblock`), when the PM is not the blocked agent, unless the agent handed the ticket over to someone else; the item's other tickets awaiting review (the ones it created that are in review, and the ones whose pull request it opened) move to `review` and go to the requester.

When:

- all of:
  - any of:
    - `hand_back_status: blocked`
    - all of:
      - `hand_back_status: done`
      - `ticket_status: blocked`
  - not:
    - `ticket_status: done, canceled`

Instruction:

```text
{{actor.id}} handed {{ticket}} back as blocked, and it is assigned to you to unblock. Try everything before involving a human: answer from what you know, find the information, or ask the right teammate with `ost ask`. When it is unblocked, comment the answer on the ticket and assign it back to {{actor.id}}. Only if a human is needed, assign it to the requester, {{requester}}, with a comment that says exactly what is needed.
```

Note posted with the change: none; the instruction is the wake's.

### idle_pulls_next

An agent with nothing queued or running is woken with its next ready ticket: the highest tracker priority, then the one ready the longest (policies.pull_ready). For a sub-ticket of an open parent the agent is woken on the parent, so it takes the sub-tickets in the order it planned.

Listens to `agent.idle`. Decides: wake `actor` (kind `assigned`), with its next ready ticket (for a sub-ticket, on its parent).

On only while `policies.pull_ready` is on.

When: always.

Instruction:

```text
You have nothing queued. Your next ready work is {{next.ticket}}. Work on it the way the repository asks.
```

## Events

Every event the pipeline decides on. A policy's `on` lists some of them.

- `chat.message`
- `pr.opened`
- `pr.review_submitted`
- `pr.comment`
- `pr.merged`
- `pr.closed`
- `pr.conflicted`
- `pr.ci_failed`
- `pr.ci_passed`
- `pr.behind_base`
- `pr.base_merged`
- `pr.linked`
- `pr.merge_checks_passed`
- `pr.merge_checks_failed`
- `ticket.commented`
- `ticket.assigned`
- `ticket.moved`
- `ticket.created`
- `ticket.unblocked`
- `ticket.closed`
- `doc.commented`
- `doc.linked`
- `agent.started`
- `agent.handed_back`
- `agent.idle`

## Instruction variables

An instruction or note may use these placeholders, written `{{name}}`. One the event does not have is empty, and an unknown name in `pipeline.policies.<id>.instruction` keeps the default instruction, with a warning in the office log.

- `ticket`
- `status`
- `actor.id`
- `actor.kind`
- `event.type`
- `pr.number`
- `pr.title`
- `pr.url`
- `pr.repo`
- `pr.base`
- `pr.head`
- `pr.author`
- `stack`
- `stack.count`
- `ticket.prs`
- `ticket.prs.count`
- `person`
- `doc.title`
- `pr.problem`
- `cause`
- `cause.number`
- `cause.title`
- `next.ticket`
- `requester`
- `blocker`
- `checks`
- `closer`
- `closed`
- `closed.at`
- `parent`
- `parent.open`
